| # bds_isobus_cfgDm3Dm11Handling {#bds_isobus_cfgdm3dm11handling-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This function registers callback functions for DM11 and DM3 respectively for the particular instance.

 

This API is not supported for CODESYS and can not be used.

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Received DM3/DM11 automatically clear the isobus failures within the DSM module. The callback can be used to perform additional actions.

- The name of the registered function can be chosen by the user.

- If callback is required for only one type of error, other callback function parameter must be passed as NULL.
